translations.web: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
translations.bsb: “I have struck your sons in vain; they accepted no discipline. Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion.”
translations.kjv: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
